name: zinterp_context_parse_int_token
description: zInterp_Context::ParseIntToken consumes the next token and parses it with atoi.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c1a20 validates NextToken consumption, null-token return of 0, and atoi(token) for present tokens.
The native smoke verifies parsing -42 and returning 0 for past-end token consumption.
